title.en: Planters lined up on newspaper-covered ground

alt.tr: Gazete serilmiş zeminde yan yana dizilmiş, vernikli ve yatay tahtalı beş ahşap çiçeklik
alt.en: Five varnished timber planters with horizontal boards lined up on a floor covered in newspaper

caption.tr: Çiçeklikler boş, içlerinde yalnızca astar var. Boyanın damlamaması için zemin gazeteyle örtülmüş.
caption.en: The planters are empty, with only the liner inside. Newspaper covers the floor to catch drips of finish.
